exposure: Histopathologic diagnosis (focal accreta, accreta, and percreta)
Area of Confluence (Acon) on three-dimensional power Doppler ultrasound
outcome: Abnormally invasive placenta requiring cesarean hysterectomy
cohort: 93 women at risk of abnormally invasive placenta
finding: Acon, a measure of confluent three-dimensional power Doppler signal at the uteroplacental interface, was significantly higher in women with abnormally invasive placenta compared to controls and increased with histopathologic severity.
